moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.description: Never misses when the weather is rainy. Has a chance (30%) of lowering the target’s Speed by 1 stat rank.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user begins flying. After a set time, the user stops flying and attacks. No other actions can be taken while flying. Most moves used by opponents will not hit the user while it is flying. If the user is hit by a sync move or max move while flying, it will stop flying.

moves.name: Black Gale Bleakwind Storm
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any moves 1 time.
Deactivation Condition: When this move is used.

Never misses. The more the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect is increased, the greater the power of this attack. Lowers the target’s Speed by 2 stat ranks. Lowers the target’s Flying Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time this attack move is successful each battle.

moves.name: Thoughts of Glory
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

moves.name: Wall for Challengers Bleakwind Storm
moves.description: This attack’s power increases when the target’s Type Rebuff is lowered.

passives.name: Unova Spirit
passives.description: Powers up the special attack moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces special attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Unova theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.)

passives.name: Season-Turning Power
passives.description: The user’s moves never miss. Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 4 stat ranks when it enters a battle. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move.

subPassives.name: Grand Entry 4

subPassives.name: P-Moves & S-Moves Crit

The more the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect is increased, the more it powers up its moves. The more the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect is increased, the more it powers up its sync move.
